role.roleTitle: Project Manager, Cold Storage Warehouse Automation

evidence.text: Project manager on a cold storage operator's automation programme for three years, running the automation projects for two frozen-goods warehouses under the operator's project method with their installation plans and phased aisle hand-overs.

Work sample: one installation plan with its phased hand-over schedule, two signed phase briefing records, one aisle acceptance pack with the manager's acceptance and one closure report, with the programme repository references as a verification trail.
Briefed the warehouse shift teams before each phase under the change briefing standard, with the briefing records signed by the shift leads; fourteen phase briefings across the two warehouses.

Interviewer 1 note: asked to brief the panel as a night shift team on a sample phase, the candidate listed the three aisles closing and the dates, showed the new pick route on the layout, named the two tasks the shift would stop doing and the one it would start, and asked the shift lead to repeat the closure dates back.

Managed the automation contractor under the works contract on both projects, with the contract records holding the site instructions and the twelve defect notices I issued with the contractor's responses.
Prepared the aisle hand-over acceptance packs; the acceptance was the warehouse manager's, recorded on each pack together with which checks were mine and which the warehouse's.

Reference call with the former head of automation projects: confirmed the candidate ran the two warehouse projects and the phase briefings in the period, that aisle acceptance stayed with the warehouse managers, and confirmed the dates.
Wrote the closure report for each warehouse with the project boundary statement and the acceptance test evidence signed by the automation contractor and the warehouse manager.
